**About The Role**
 COUNTRY Financial is seeking an experienced Integration Developer to help expand our enterprise integration capabilities using Azure Integration Services, specifically Azure Logic Apps, Functions/Durable Functions, Service Bus, Event Hubs/Grid, Fabric, and Azure API Management.
   

  

**Role**
 This role will work alongside an established integration team currently leveraging Informatica CDI\-PC/ IDMC, MuleSoft, and IBM Business Automation Workflow (BAW), and will play a key role in:
   

  

* Developing application centric, API led integrations on Azure
* Supporting our public cloud migration and modernization initiatives
* Establishing patterns, standards, and best practices for Azure native integrations


 This is a hands on developer role with strong influence on future integration architecture and will work in collaboration with our Engineering CoE team.
   

  

 Azure Integration Development
   

  

* Design, develop, and support integrations using Azure Functions and Azure Logic Apps (Consumption and Standard)
* Build, publish, and manage APIs using Azure API Management (policies, products, versioning, security)
* Implement synchronous and asynchronous integration patterns using HTTP, REST, messaging, and event driven approaches
* Develop integration solutions aligned with application centric and API led architecture principles.


 Enterprise Integration \& Collaboration
   

  

* Collaborates with BAW, Informatica and MuleSoft developers to implement hybrid integration solutions
* Translate existing BAW, MuleSoft or Informatica patterns into Azure native equivalents where appropriate
* Partner with Integration CoE, Enterprise Architecture and Security to ensure compliance with integration standards and policies
* Participate in design reviews, architecture discussions, and platform evaluations


 Operational Excellence
   

  

* Implement monitoring, logging, and alerting for integrations
* Support CI/CD pipelines (Git based) for integration assets
* Experience with Bicep IaC
* Troubleshoot and resolve integration defects and performance issues
* Familiarity with Azure Monitor, Application Insights, Log Analytics and Dynatrace
* Produce and maintain technical documentation and integration runbooks


**How does this role make an impact?**
* Designs solutions after gathering business and technical requirements. \- Develops software solutions that are high performing and meet technical standards. \- Supports testing and problem solving/debugging of solutions. \- Implements software solutions following best practices.

* Typically requires 10\+ years of relevant experience or a combination of related experience, education and training.

* Azure Logic Apps
* Azure API Management
* Strong experience building RESTful APIs and service based integrations

**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience modernizing or migrating integrations to Azure native platforms
* Knowledge of Enterprise Integration Patterns (EIP)
* Experience supporting insurance or financial services environments
* Familiarity with secure coding standards (OWASP, NIST, CIS)
